channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 11
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 11 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 11: The September 29 timeline entry still described the…
item.description: The September 29 timeline entry still described the Mayor's approval and enactment as still to come. The Legistar pages list both as done on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26), and the entry now points to the October 13 entry. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 11: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 11: 145 ft. They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (130 ft) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.
item.source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'

item.title: Added · Potrero Power Station Block 11: The Planning Department's October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval…
item.description: The Planning Department's October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval includes Block 11, so the record now shows 'Planned · Approved'. This is approval of the development phase, not of the building's design, which has not been approved as far as we found. Source: Planning Department, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Applications: Development Phase Approval, Oct 7, 2020 (149 pages; sfplanning.org Potrero Power Station page, M-Files link), PDF p. 4: "approves the Phase 1 Plan Application dated October 6, 2020".

item.description: The City's Legistar pages for the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) list both as passed and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Mayor approved; enactment numbers 208-26 and 209-26). item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated… (Oct 13, 2026)
item.description: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): Legistar lists both as 'Status: Passed' with 'Final action: 10/13/2026', 'Enactment date: 10/13/2026' and enactment numbers 208-26 (File 260724) and 209-26 (File 260770), and a history row '10/13/2026 ... Mayor ... APPROVED' for each. The Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes) is the previous entry on this timeline. October 13, 2026 is the enactment date, from the Clerk of the Board's listing (page read October 14 and again October 17, 2026); it is an event date. Both ordinances provide 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a), p. 56 of its 'Leg Final' attachment; File 260724, p. 10 of its attachment); counted from October 13, 2026 that is November 13, 2026, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text. (Oct 13, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Board of Supervisors finally passes the… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: Board of Supervisors finally passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement ordinance (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): the Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachment to each file lists 'October 06, 2026 Board of Supervisors - FINALLY PASSED', 'Ayes: 11 - Chan, Chen, Dorsey, Fielder, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill, Walton and Wong' (File 260724 attachment pp. 11-12; File 260770 attachment pp. 58-59), and the Clerk's certificate says each ordinance 'was FINALLY PASSED on 10/6/2026 by the Board of Supervisors'. The date is the Board's vote date, an event date. The Legistar history row for 10/6/2026 on each file's web page carries no action text, so the attachment is the source for this entry. The Mayor's approval and enactment followed on October 13, 2026 (next entry). (Oct 6, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Block 11's mapping notes now cite the final Design…
item.description: Block 11's mapping notes now cite the final Design for Development (Feb 26, 2020, Figure 6.2.3 and Table 3.1.1) instead of a dead 2019 draft link. An unsourced '85-145 ft range' and a Keyser Marston / '~500,000 GSF' comparison were removed, the architect statement was corrected (the Meyers+ page and the June 2020 pre-application slides do list Herzog & de Meuron + Adamson for Blocks 11, 12 and 15), and the Power Station Park statement was corrected (the strip next to Block 15 is Louisiana Paseo). The 430,000 sq ft figure is now described as office, per the project's engineer, not a life-science campus. The caveat no longer says no Assessor parcel exists: an active unaddressed lot (4232021) overlaps most of the footprint but is not confirmed as this block's parcel. The 2028 completion is kept as a soft 2020 Phase 1 forecast, the July 2026 height request is no longer marked as expected, and a Chronicle title, D4D publisher, Meyers+ date and one image kind were corrected. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); Meyers+ Engineers, Potrero Power Station Blocks 11, 12 & 15 project page (https://www.meyersplus.com/potrero-power-station); California Barrel Company, Blocks 11, 12, 15 pre-application meeting slides, 2020-06-07 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropowerstn_Design_Review_Pre-App_Community%20Mtg-0060720.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-07-29 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/one-s-f-s-biggest-developments-changing-plans-22365461.php).

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Developer requests a Development Agreement… (~Jul 2026)
item.description: Developer requests a Development Agreement amendment increasing Block 11's permitted height by 15 feet, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants; the Chronicle's July 29, 2026 article says the Planning Commission considered the request 'On Thursday' (the hearing date is not stated there) and that the Planning Department had recommended approval; the SF Standard reported on August 3, 2026 that 'The commissioners approved unanimously, sending the decision to the Board of Supervisors'; the Board of Supervisors then passed the amendment package on first reading on Sep 29, 2026 (next entry) (~Jul 2026). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29; The San Francisco Standard, 2026-08-03.
item.source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2026-07-29; The San Francisco Standard, 2026-08-03

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Completion expected: Block 11 is part of Phase… (~2027)
item.description: Completion expected: Block 11 is part of Phase 1 (per the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list, Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15); SocketSite's October 2020 'Re-Phase Program, Detailed Construction Schedule' table gives Block 11 vertical development 2025 to 2027 (the same article's text says the first phase would be completed in 2028, and its table runs Block 12 to 2029 and Phase 1 open space to 2029); a 2020 forecast, not a current Block 11 date (~2027). Source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07; SocketSite, 2020-10-09; California Barrel Company LLC / Found Middle LP, submitted to SF Planning Department, 2025-03-28.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Planning Department approves the Phase 1… (Oct 7, 2020)
item.description: Planning Department approves the Phase 1 Development Phase Application, which includes Block 11 (Development Phase Approval dated October 7, 2020, Case No. 2017-011878PHA, signed by Planning Director Rich Hillis): the approval lists 'Block 11 – Includes construction of approximately 219,000 square feet of commercial, 5,000 square feet of retail, 6,000 square feet of PDR, 6,000 square feet of childcare, and approximately 48,500 square feet of accessory parking uses' (PDF p. 16), says the first phase consists of 'vertical improvements to Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, and 15' (PDF p. 2), and its Decision reads 'approves the Phase 1 Plan Application dated October 6, 2020' (PDF p. 4). The approval moves 'the construction of commercial buildings on Blocks 11, 12, and 15' into Development Phase 1 (PDF p. 3). The date is the approval's own date, an event date. This approves the development phase, not Block 11's building design; no design review approval has been found for the block. (Oct 7, 2020). Source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07.
item.source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 11: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 11 as a development block; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date. (Block 11 was later named one of Phase 1's six blocks by the October 2020 Phase 1 Development Phase Application – a construction-phase assignment, not when it first entered the plan.) (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning, 2020-02-26; SF Planning, 2020-10-07.
